message: Hook does not end on sentence punctuation; check it reads as a complete thought at the fold.
LinkedIn shows markdown as literal characters. Found: bold (**text**), heading (# Heading), bullet (- item).
External links in the body reduce reach: https://northwind.example/audit. Move them to the first comment.
Contains banned or cliché wording: "game changer".
5 hashtags present, but the voice asks for 0–3.
Emoji use matches the configured policy.
"Thoughts?" would close any post. Ask for something that follows from this one.
Engagement bait detected. LinkedIn penalises posts that ask for interactions this way.
"45%" does not appear in this post's evidence or the author's details. Remove it or use a figure from the evidence.
All-caps words detected (NEED, KNOW, THIS, NOW). Reads as shouting.
"studies show" names no source. Name who said it, or leave the claim out.
